summary_text:
LEGAL SUMMARY:

The case is listed in the court of the Junior Civil Judge at Chennur, present Sri G. Uday Bhaskar Rao, CC. The complainant is the State of Telangana, represented by Sub-Inspector of Police, Kotapally, and the accused is Jangelli Ganganna @ Narayana. A docket order was issued on 07.03.2018, by Order No. 1105/2018/crl, from the Hon'ble District and Session Judge Adilabad, permitting entry of the case in the LPC Register. The case was recorded under Section No. 135 of 1998. The order was given under the hand and seal of the Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, on the 13th day of March, 2018.

[Note: The legal basis of Section 135 of 1998 is not specified in the evidence. The reference to "Section No. 135 of 1998" is taken as a direct citation from the evidence, but the full statutory provision or its legal meaning is not provided in the supplied evidence.]
